therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor angiogenesis and growth factor signaling inhibition

results.effect_size: HR 0.92 (95% CI: 0.72-1.19) by independent radiology assessment
subgroup_findings: Independent radiology assessment: median PFS 8.6 vs 8.3 months
Investigator assessment: median PFS 8.2 vs 6.9 months
safety_signals: Cardiac events including atrial fibrillation, AV block, cardiac arrest in combination arm
results.dose_information: Sunitinib 37.5 mg daily oral in 2/1 schedule with Docetaxel 75 mg/m2 every 3 weeks, or 37.5 mg continuous dosing; Control: Docetaxel 100 mg/m2 every 3 weeks
